LTSR.description: Limiting Slenderness Ratio (LTSR). Defines the allowable slenderness ratio limits (compression and tension) applied per element for SRC design, with an option to skip the check.

bNOTCHECK.description: Do not check the slenderness ratio. When true, the limiting slenderness ratio verification is skipped for the element.

COMP.description: Limiting slenderness ratio for compression members.

TENS.description: Limiting slenderness ratio for tension members.
